missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Дым' is the masculine nominative subject of 'идёт'. 'Из трубы' is the genitive source after 'из', a vivid everyday image.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Дым' is the accusative direct object of 'чувствую'; as an inanimate masculine noun its accusative matches the nominative. 'На кухне' is the prepositional place.
Strategic focus: Genitive after a quantity word. 'Дыма' is the genitive required after 'много'. 'В комнате' is the prepositional place, a useful pattern for amounts.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Дыму' is the dative case required by 'радовались', the thing they were glad about. 'Из печи' is the genitive source.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Дымом' is instrumental, marking what covers the sky. 'Чёрным' agrees in the masculine instrumental, a striking descriptive line.

missions.phrase: Мы говорили о дыме над городом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О дыме' uses the prepositional form 'дыме' after 'о'. 'Над городом' is the instrumental of position, describing where the smoke hangs.
Strategic focus: Locative prepositional in -у. 'Дым' takes the special locative ending 'дыму' after 'в' to mean inside the smoke. 'Трудно дышать' is the impersonal predicate.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Дым' is the masculine nominative subject of 'поднимался'. 'Медленно' describes the manner and 'вверх' the direction, a calm narrative line.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with 'за'. 'Дымом' is instrumental after 'за', showing what the city disappeared behind. 'Пожаров' is the genitive plural source of the smoke.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Дым' is the masculine nominative subject of two verbs joined by 'и'. A natural way to describe the unpleasant effect of smoke.
